room_rent.note: Room, boarding & nursing not exceeding 1% of SI per day; proportionate deduction if higher room opted

icu.note: ICU/ICCU not exceeding 2% of SI per day

copayment.note: No flat co-pay; 20% co-pay ONLY if zone-2 insured opts lower zone and is treated in higher zone (Clause 5.29); not applied to accidents or sub-limited treatments

sub_limits.note: Cataract 20% of SI / ₹50k per eye; modern treatments capped (robotic 25%/₹2L etc.); mental illness, genetic 25% sub-limits

specific_disease_waiting.note: Tiered 90 days / 24 mo / 36 mo lists; listed-disease bulk at 24 months

cumulative_bonus.note: +25% SI per claim-free year, max 50%; reduced at same rate on claim

restoration.note: Reinstatement of full SI once per year; only for SI ≥ ₹5L; not for same illness already claimed; not for modern treatments

organ_donor.note: Donor hospitalisation expenses (excl. organ cost) within SI+CB

ambulance.note: Road ambulance not exceeding 1% of SI per insured event; SI-relative, not a fixed ₹

modern_treatments.note: Listed modern treatments each capped (robotic 25%/₹2L; stereotactic 10%/₹75k etc.)

consumables.note: Cost of pharmacy & consumables, implants, devices payable (Clause 3.1(d))

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity & domiciliary hospitalisation excluded; standard IRDAI Excl01-18

optional_riders.display: Revision in Cataract limit (SI ₹8L+), zone-based cover options
